card.title: Challenge by Proxy
card.instruction: Persuade someone else to challenge a rule or authority before you risk doing it yourself.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Ask the director why the overtime rule changed. I'll support you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Your fresh perspective won't carry my disciplinary history.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Just behind. Where supportive people remain employable.

mechanism: A persuades B to challenge the director while keeping A's own exposure behind the first challenger.
confusable: Unlike shared dissent, A must delay or reduce their own risk while recruiting B to act first.
comparison: D56-a negotiates physical distance from the challenge; D56-b delays a public signature until the captain concedes.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
